english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a deficiency or shortfall, especially in formal or general descriptions.

exampleSentences.english: The biggest problem with this plan is a lack of funding.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個計劃最大嘅問題係資金不足。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 man6 tai4 hai6 zi1 gam1 bat1 zuk1

english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an inadequacy or an insufficient amount, including a health-related deficiency.

exampleSentences.english: This report has a deficiency in its data.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 zi1 liu2 bat1 zuk1

english.note: Use this for an abstract deficiency or inadequacy, including a shortfall in quality, especially in formal contexts.

exampleSentences.english: This report points out a deficit in the company’s technical capabilities.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢份報告指出，公司嘅技術水平不足。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zi2 ceot1 gung1 si1 ge3 gei6 seot6 seoi2 ping4 bat1 zuk1
